arguments.sql:
WITH endpoints_per_bond AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS endpoint_rows
    FROM main.bond AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    GROUP BY b.bond_id, b.bond_type
)
SELECT 'bond type and connection row count' AS diagnostic,
       bond_type AS stored_value, endpoint_rows AS detail, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM endpoints_per_bond
GROUP BY bond_type, endpoint_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'molecule label', label, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM main.molecule
GROUP BY label
UNION ALL
SELECT 'atom element', element, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM main.atom
GROUP BY element
UNION ALL
SELECT 'element lookup row', element_id, element_name, COUNT(*)
FROM main.element
GROUP BY element_id, element_name

arguments.sql:
WITH carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element = 'c' THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS element
    FROM main.bond AS b
    JOIN main.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN main.connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN main.atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN main.atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE m.label = '-'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
      AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
)
SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM carbon_bonds
GROUP BY element
